name: stellar-identity-suite
description: Monorepo for the Stellar Identity & Authentication Suite: stellar-id-core (Soroban contract), stellar-id-client (TypeScript SDK), stellar-id-frontend (React components), stellar-id-docs (Docusaurus). Split into four repositories after Phase 7.

scripts.verify:core: cd stellar-id-core && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test && stellar contract build
scripts.verify: pnpm verify:core && pnpm verify:client && pnpm verify:frontend && pnpm verify:docs
